definitions.explanation: An abbreviation combining Japan/Japanese and England/English. Most commonly refers to the Japanese-English language pair in the context of dictionaries, translation, and language study.

examples.japanese: {日英|にちえい}{辞典|じてん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: Look something up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: この{文書|ぶんしょ}は{日英|にちえい}{両方|りょうほう}で{作成|さくせい}されている。
examples.english: This document has been prepared in both Japanese and English.

examples.japanese: {日英|にちえい}{翻訳|ほんやく}では{文化的|ぶんかてき}な{背景|はいけい}の{違|ちが}いを{理解|りかい}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: In Japanese-to-English translation, it is important to understand differences in cultural background.

notes:
An abbreviation combining {日|にち} (Japan/Japanese) and {英|えい} (English/Britain). Most commonly refers to the Japanese-English language pair (for dictionaries, translation, etc.), but can also refer to Japan-Britain relations in diplomatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日英|にちえい}{辞典|じてん}: Japanese-English dictionary
- {日英|にちえい}{翻訳|ほんやく}: Japanese-to-English translation
- {日英|にちえい}{対訳|たいやく}: Japanese-English parallel text
- {日英|にちえい}{同盟|どうめい}: Anglo-Japanese Alliance (historical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {英和|えいわ}: English-Japanese — the reverse direction (English to Japanese)
- {和英|わえい}: Japanese-English — synonym using {和|わ} instead of {日|にち}
- {日米|にちべい}: Japan-America — similar pattern with the U.S.
